observations: body L1: the u of «figuram» is covered by a blot.

body L1-L4: in the triangle ELB, right-angled at L and taken as plane, the angles at E and B make 90°, so that LEB is the angle of latitude, and the law of sines gives L4; the exact rule of the right spherical triangle is tan BL = tan EB cos EBL = tan β sin ang. latit. : R. The bars after «90°» (L2) and those of L5, L7, L10, L21 and L22 (9.1 to 10.2 pt, as long as the signs of equality) are minus signs.
body L5-L10: ZB = ζ, and KB = BL, the triangles ELB and BKD being equal (p. 259, L38-L40). Ptolemy (Almagest V, 19) puts the arcs for their sines: L9 and L10.
body L11: «ZE = ζ» is printed for ZE = z: ζ is ZB, the zenith distance of the degree of the Moon (p. 259, L26), z that of the Moon (L13, L16, L17). «369–370» has a long dash (5.4 pt).
body L13: the bars over ZL and EL mark the arcs taken as straight lines; a speck prints before ZL.
body L14: «Al–Battānī» has a long dash (5.4 pt), as in L23 and L37; the hyphen of «sub-» prints short and high (1.8 pt).

body L17-L23: cos ZE = cos EL cos ZL is the rule of the spherical triangle ELZ right-angled at L, and the three lines that follow are exact; al-Battānī's rule ((α), p. 259, L29) drops the term sin² EL sin² ZL. Heavy brackets open (L17) and close (L35) Schiaparelli's addition. The full stop after the formula of L23 stands at mid-height.

body L24-L29: with β = 5° and EBZ = 23° 35′, sin EL = sin 5° sin 23° 35′ gives EL = 1° 59′ 55″, the 2° 0′ printed; sin² 2° 0′ = 1 : 821.0, and the error of sin z, and so of the parallax in altitude, is at most half of it, 1 : 1642: 3″,7 of Ptolemy's greatest parallax of the Moon, 1° 42′ 1/2 at 33 1/2 radii. But 23° 35′, the obliquity, bounds the angle EBZ, the angle of longitude, only when the Moon is in the meridian, where it lies between 0° and 23° 35′ (p. 258, formula (α)). Elsewhere it is greater: on the horizon it is the angle of the ecliptic with the horizon (p. 258, L22), which at latitude 36° reaches 77° 34′; EL then becomes 4° 53′, sin² EL 1 : 138, and the error of the parallax up to 1 : 276 of it, 22″. The bar of the fraction in L27 prints broken.

body L32: «differentia inter arcus ZE, EL»: EL is at most β, while ZE may be any zenith distance; the difference which is small except near the zenith, where ZE spans few degrees, is that of ZE and ZL (cos ZE = cos EL cos ZL, L19), so ZL is meant for EL.

body L35-L37: the dashes before «Schiaparelli» and after «angulorum.» measure 10.0 and 10.1 pt. «l. l.» is Almagest V, 19; T and H are the points where the vertical circles through E and D meet the ecliptic (p. 259, the second figure). The crossbar of the H of «AHZ» prints faint.
